instruction: Apply 1.5 line spacing to every paragraph throughout the document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting line spacing to 1.5 for all paragraphs. Current document has mixed line spacing (None and 1.158). Evaluator checks if all non-empty paragraphs have line spacing set to 1.5. Verified that document currently has different spacing values, so modification is required.
